asks: Is this how tall people are?
Would you say the hands are the problem?
description: A person stands here a full head taller than they should be, proportioned by somebody working from a description rather than a memory. It is a good try and it is not right.
emotes: {it} lowers itself slightly, as though trying to be less tall, and gives up.
{it} rearranges its face into a smile in two separate movements.
{it} takes a step and covers rather more ground than the step should have.
looks: The arms are a joint too long, and the hands hang lower than hands hang.
The face is assembled correctly. It is simply assembled.
It stands the way somebody stands when they are waiting to be told where to stand.
name: a very tall person who is nearly right
says: I got most of it right.
You are the first person to look properly.
Do not worry about it. Nobody else has.
